notes.title: Thanks for playing and 1.0.1 patch notes!
notes.notes:
First of all thanks a lot to everyone who played Kity Builder! We've loved watching your streams, screenshots in Steam Workshop and of course your very nice reviews 😻.



The team has taken a small break after all the hard work that went into releasing the game in the best shape we could, but since a few bugs and typos went under our radar, we've fixed those:

Fixed English typos and strings that were in the wrong place

Now you can use the R00MB4 to paint a few zones you couldn't before

Updated a few names in the credits



We look forward to sharing more news with you, but for now, we'll keep enjoying our little summer break from working on the game :)



-Mau from Team Kity
